answer: Cap how fast new identities can start earning: each epoch the network opens a fixed number of onboarding seats, and newcomers queue for them. A sybil farm can wander in with a thousand accounts, but they all rise on the same slow tide as everyone else, so flooding buys a longer queue, not more reward. Behind that velvet rope, seats go to whoever has waited longest with clean attestations, so patience, not account count, decides who earns.
